title: Sattu Sharbat
description: A salty-sour Bihari summer cooler of roasted gram flour with lemon, cumin and mint, filling and cooling.
steps: Put the sattu in a large jug and add about 100 ml of the cold water, whisking to a smooth paste with no lumps.
Add the remaining water gradually while whisking.
Stir in the lemon juice, black salt and roasted cumin powder.
Add the mint leaves and green chilli, taste and adjust, then serve cold over ice.
